rationale: Both Dahilon and Angelo are building in fintech but with complementary focuses—Dahilon is developing Finlingo as a financial services product with strong AI/data science capabilities, while Angelo is co-founding Mavu Labs to build trust and compliance infrastructure for the same sector. Angelo's deep conviction around regulatory compliance and blockchain could directly inform Finlingo's product roadmap, while Dahilon's technical foundation in Python, Java, and TypeScript complements Angelo's infrastructure-focused approach.
intro_message: Dahilon Mohammed, meet Angelo Kalaw — you're both building critical pieces of fintech infrastructure and could learn a lot from each other's approaches to financial services and compliance.
